plan: My goal is to maximize profit. Given my value of $28, I need to bid strategically to win when profitable and avoid overpaying. In a first-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true value is a common strategy, but this is a second-price auction. In a second-price auction, bidding your true value (or slightly below) is often optimal. I will bid slightly below my value to ensure a profit if I win, but not too low to risk losing to a slightly lower bid.

My goal is to maximize profit. Since this is the first round and I have no history, I will bid based on a common strategy for second-price auctions. I will bid my true value, $31. This strategy is dominant in second-price auctions, as it maximizes my expected utility by ensuring I only win when my value is higher than the second-highest bid and I pay that second-highest bid.
